title: A crude bound for the class number of the standard definite hermitian genus, and divisibility of indices of submodules
summary: Two independent pieces of bookkeeping. (1) Space.card_classes_le: for a CM field E with a nonzero natural number N in its different, the number of classes Γ_f\G_f/K_f of the standard definite hermitian space of rank n is at most (1 + 2C³)^{4fn²}, C = 6N(fn)², by mapping each class injectively to the integral, archimedean-bounded entries of two matrices built from a short basis. (2) IndexDvd M N z, a divisibility form of 'the index of N in M divides z' (every finite family in M is moved into N by a square matrix whose determinant divides z), with its calculus: pull-back, push-forward, transitivity, spans, composition, products of operators of a given type (HasType: y(M) ⊆ M and y(M) + pⁿM has index dividing p^l with l ≤ c), and the determinant criterion over a valuation domain (IndexDvd.of_det_dvd).

members.name: Space.card_classes_le
members.text: Let E be a CM field with a CM type (CMType E: a CM number field with a chosen complex embedding Φ_w inducing each infinite place w), N a nonzero natural number (NeZero N) whose image in the ring of integers lies in the different ideal of E (h), and n a finite index type. Then the number of classes of the standard definite hermitian space of rank |n| at the level K_f, i.e. Nat.card of StdClasses (Kf E n) = Γ_f\G_f/K_f (G_f the finite adelic unitary group of the identity form on E^n, Γ_f its rational points, K_f = G_f ∩ GL_n(Ô) the stabiliser of the standard lattice Ô^n), is at most (1 + 2·C³)^{4·f·|n|²}, where C = shortBasisConst E n N = 6·N·(f·|n|)² and f = numInfPlaces E is the number of infinite places of E.

members.name: IndexDvd
members.text: For a commutative ring O, an O-module V, submodules M, N ⊆ V and an element z ∈ O: IndexDvd M N z holds when for every natural number n and every family Φ_1, …, Φ_n of elements of M there is an n×n matrix m over O whose determinant divides z such that every combination Σ_k m_{ik}·Φ_k (i = 1, …, n) lies in N. (A divisibility form of 'the index of N in M divides z'; when M ⊆ N, m = 1 works.) The definition takes M, N, z as explicit arguments (variable (M N z) in).

lemma IndexDvd.comp (e : M.map f ≤ M) : IndexDvd M (M.map f ⊔ a • M) z → IndexDvd M (N ⊔ a • M) z' →
  IndexDvd M (N.map f ⊔ a • M) (z * z')

    HasType z M s (L.map T).prod (L.map t).sum
members.text: Exponents add under products. For a commutative ring O, an O-module V, an index type ι, a submodule M ⊆ V, z ∈ O, a natural number s, endomorphisms T(l) of V and real numbers t(l) (l ∈ ι), and a list L of indices: if HasType z M s (T l) (t l) for every l in L, then HasType z M s (Π_{l∈L} T(l)) (Σ_{l∈L} t(l)), where the product is the composition T(l₁)∘T(l₂)∘⋯ in the order of the list (the empty product is the identity) and the sum is the sum of the t(l) over the list.

members.name: IndexDvd.of_det_dvd
members.statement_lean:
lemma IndexDvd.of_det_dvd [IsDomain O] [ValuationRing O] [Fintype ι] {A : Matrix ι ι O} {N}
    (h : A.det ∣ z) (e : .map A.mulVecLin ⊤ ≤ N) : IndexDvd ⊤ N z
members.text: Determinant criterion. Let O be a valuation domain (an integral domain whose ideals are totally ordered: ValuationRing O), ι a finite type, z ∈ O, A an ι×ι matrix over O with det A dividing z (h), and N ⊆ O^ι a submodule containing the image A(O^ι) (e). Then IndexDvd O^ι N z (the whole module ⊤ on the left).
